Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: UNCDF’s Sudan Payment Infrastructure Assessment describes a national retail payments switch (Electronic Banking Service Company, EBS) with all 38 banks connected as direct participants and interoperable with mobile money operators, plus SRAG RTGS (launched 2008, mandatory for banks) and Electronic Cheque Clearing (ECC, launched 2006, integrated with SRAG). It also notes mobile money operators licensed by CBOS and integrated into the national switch, but no evidence of a modern 24/7 instant retail payment system; cross-border connectivity is absent.
